acceptance_checks.description: Sacred document `_context/sacred/tech-stack.md` exists and is present
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@architect stack-evaluation` then `stack-locking` to produce the locked tech-stack.
Check that `tech-stack.md` frontmatter includes `derived_from`, `sacred: true`, `governance`, and `workflowType`. Re-run stack-locking to regenerate if missing.

acceptance_checks.description: An accepted ADR exists in `_context/planning/adrs/` for each decision_area in the shortlist; each ADR validates against `schemas/planning-artefacts/adr.schema.json`
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@architect stack-evaluation` for any decision area missing an ADR. Each ADR must include `tier`, `rubric`, `chosen`, and `status: accepted`.
Run stack-locking Step 4 to emit the stack-selection-summary distillate.

acceptance_checks.description: `coldpress.yaml stack_pack` field is set (empty string `""` is legal = no pack, generic path)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Stack-locking Step 4 writes `stack_pack` to coldpress.yaml. If missing, re-run stack-locking from step-04-lock.

acceptance_checks.description: `coldpress.yaml baselines:` block exists and every category from `data/standards/baselines.yaml` is represented with a valid status
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run stack-locking Step 5b (baselines confirmation) to write the `baselines:` block. All four categories (seo_aeo_llm, accessibility, security, future_proof) must have a status.

acceptance_checks.description: User has reviewed and accepted `_context/sacred/tech-stack.md` (sacred-doc protection active)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Review the locked stack + rationale in `tech-stack.md` and confirm acceptance. This activates sacred-doc governance protection.

acceptance_checks.description: If any supersede fired in Phase 3, `_context/audit/supersessions-{date}.md` has at least one entry after `phase_3_started_at`
acceptance_checks.remediation: If a Phase 3 artefact superseded a `_input/` document, ensure the supersessions log was written. Run `@valet propose-change` to capture the decision.

acceptance_checks.description: `stack-shortlist-v{N}.md pack_match.matched_pack_name` is set OR user confirmed no-match (`matched_pack_name == null AND user_confirmed == true`)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run stack-discovery-sync Step 3 to score pack candidates. If no pack applies, explicitly confirm the no-match in the shortlist frontmatter.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/audit/baselines-confirmations-*.md` has entries for this Phase 3 run
acceptance_checks.remediation: Baselines confirmations log is written during stack-locking Step 5b. If missing, record decisions manually per `docs/baselines-confirmations-log-spec.md`.

acceptance_checks.description: Development environment installs cleanly: deps installed, lint/format/hooks configured, baselines activated
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@developer env-provision` to install dependencies and configure tooling. Investigate any install failures before proceeding to Phase 4.

acceptance_checks.description: `.coldpress/local-config.yaml post_phase_3_update_ran: true` — confirms `coldpress update --post-phase-3` was run to regenerate stack-pack wrappers
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `coldpress update --post-phase-3` in your terminal to regenerate skill wrappers for the locked stack pack. Return to Butler and confirm.

acceptance_checks.description: ★ NON-NEGOTIABLE (both lanes). A hello-world walking skeleton is deployed to staging through the entire locked stack + deploy pack and smokes green — the single best de-risking step for 'deploy anywhere' (WS10-A6). Gate key: `gates.p3.walking_skeleton_deployed: true` in .coldpress/state.yaml.
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@architect walking-skeleton`: scaffold a hello-world, build it with the locked stack, deploy to staging via the selected deploy pack, and smoke it. It sets `gates.p3.walking_skeleton_deployed`. Never cut — this proves the pipeline before any feature is built.

acceptance_checks.description: The locked dependency set passes the licence policy (no GPL/AGPL/SSPL in client-shipped code) — run at lock time so a licence problem surfaces while swapping a dependency is still cheap (re-run at P9 readiness). Gate key: `gates.p3.license_scan_clean: true`.
acceptance_checks.remediation: The `walking-skeleton` skill runs the licence scan over the locked deps and sets `gates.p3.license_scan_clean`. Resolve any GPL/AGPL/SSPL dependency (swap it, or move it out of client-shipped code) before Phase 4.
